title: Show YAML and JSON files in the doc drawer, formatted and foldable
notes:
The drawer's docs tree lists only .md files, and its viewer renders only markdown. The user wants .yaml/.yml and .json files there too (the project's docs/ and, on the manager tab, ~/.dashboard and ~/.claude, e.g. projects.yaml, settings.json).

- List .yaml, .yml and .json beside .md in the tree, under the same roots and the same docs:read refusal rules (only those extensions, only under the allowed roots).
- The viewer shows them formatted: syntax colours for keys, strings, numbers, booleans, null, comments (YAML); JSON pretty-printed with two-space indent; a file that does not parse is shown as plain text with one line saying where it failed.
- Collapse: every object and array (YAML mapping and sequence) can be folded and unfolded. Keyboard first (conventions-rule-1): arrow keys walk the foldable lines, Right/Left or Enter unfold and fold, a key folds or unfolds all; a click on the fold marker does the same. Long files open with only the top level unfolded.
- The Edit row opens the file in nvim as for markdown.
- Use the yaml package already in the project (yaml@2.9.1) for parsing; no new dependency for a highlighter unless the one the chat uses (highlight.js) already covers it.
- The fold logic (which lines fold, what is open) is a small module with a test (workflow-rule-2). docs/drawer and help updated within BLURB_WORD_LIMIT.

Shipped in #210: the drawer lists .yaml, .yml and .json beside .md (dot-named files such as ~/.claude/.credentials.json never); the viewer shows them highlighted, JSON pretty-printed, every multi-line object and array foldable by keyboard and click, long docs open at the top level, a parse failure shown as text with where it failed. Not checked by hand in the app.
